desc: Bernadette walks in with Amy, holding up a white canvas bag by its handles, extending her arm out in front of her, at chest level.
Bernadette touches a red dress that Amy is holding up as they stand in front of the blue couch.
Amy folds a red dress against her body while standing next to Bernadette in front of the blue couch.
Raj, sitting on the couch between Sheldon and Howard, who are eating, rubs his eyes with a bored expression.
Raj, in a red and blue track jacket, presses his palms together and taps his fingers excitedly, smiling on the couch.
Penny, wearing a blue shirt, sits on a couch scrolling through her phone, then puts the phone on the table while standing up.
Penny sighs and rolls her eyes, irritated, while standing in front of Sheldon, then walks to the fridge touching her forehead and opens it.
Leonard finishes fixing Sheldon's bow tie, claps his hands in acceptance, and walks away.
Sheldon swings the suit jacket over his shoulder to put the jacket on.
Sheldon picks us a flask and places it in the inside pocket of his suit jacket.
Leonard walks past Sheldon in suit and pats him on the shoulder.
Leonard knocks on Penny's door, standing outside the door with Sheldon in a tuxedo.
Penny, in a red dress, comes out of her apartment to Leonard and Sheldon, both in suits, place her hands on hips, then greets Leonard with a kiss.
Penny, in a red dress, rests her arms on Leonard's shoulder while smiling at him, as Amy, in a blue dress, stands at the doorway.
Stressed Sheldon, in a suit, gulps hard, then runs away through the hallway to the door.
Emily is pouring champagne from a bottle into a glass, in the limousine with Raj, Howard, and Bernadette.
Emily, while sitting in the limousine next to Raj on the phone, shows her tattoo on her shoulder blade.
A shot of a rooftop decorated for a party, as Penny and Leonard come in amazed.
Penny, in a red dress, starts to laugh at Leonard, and hugs him on the rooftop decorated for a party.
Sheldon lies on his bed in a white shirt and suit pants, looking at his phone in silence.
A wide shot of Raj, Emily, Bernadette, Howard and Stuart with a woman, sitting in the limo, drinking champagne.
Stuart, in a suit, points to the woman sitting next to him in the limo with his thumb.
While dancing, Penny puts her hand in Leonard's hand, removes it and puts her arms around Leonard's neck.
Penny grabs Leonard to slow dance on the rooftop, her hand resting on his shoulder and their other hands clasped together.
Leonard, in a suit, moves his hands from Penny's hands to her waist while they dance together on the rooftop.
Howard is angrily shaking Stuart in a car and Bernadette is trying to pull him off.
Amy starts breathing heavily, mouth wide open and hand placed on her chest, during her talk with Sheldon in a suit.
Amy, in a blue dress, rushes past Sheldon, in a suit, to his bed during their conversation
Leonard and Penny are posing in front of a photographer at the rooftop party.
Sheldon and Amy pose for a picture that Raj is taking, at the rooftop party.
A shot of a photo taken of Amy and Sheldon, standing under a blue-decorated arch, both smiling with their eyes closed.
Howard and Bernadette pose for a picture that Raj is taking, at the rooftop party.
A shot of a photo taken of Bernadette and Howard standing under a blue-decorated arch, both making surprised, exaggerated faces at the camera.
Stuart and a woman, in a yellow dress, pose for a picture that Raj is taking, at the rooftop party, when he answers the phone.
